dct_description_sm: This dataset and accompanying schema were prepared to support standardized documentation, organization, validation, and long-term reuse of genomic sequencing project data. The schema provides structured fields for recording sample information, sequencing metadata, laboratory and bioinformatics information, and associated project-level information. It was developed to improve consistency in the capture and management of genomic sequencing data, facilitate harmonization across sequencing projects and workflows, and support interoperability with Agri-Food Data Canada (ADC) tools and repository standards. The schema is intended to facilitate reproducible data management and downstream reuse of genomic sequencing datasets.
Structural schema for sequencing runs, samples, workflow definitions, workflow executions, QC metrics, QC rule definitions, QC rule evaluations, and final sample status.
